name: Toba Setsuna
source: Another Toba Setsuna who born from her wish and separated from original later. This Toba Setsuna is current generation of Evil Sorcerer but not like Setsuna, she inherit trait as evil sorcerer more than her together with magic power that are collected from misfortune in Yugahara. She only appear in Setsuna route
